description: comdirect is a German direct bank brand of Commerzbank. Its public developer-facing documentation on comdirect.de focuses on PSD2 open-banking access for third-party providers and customer account/brokerage API information.
summary: comdirect exposes one documented HTTP integration surface on its own domain: a PSD2/XS2A Berlin Group REST API at `https://xs2a-api.comdirect.de` with a downloadable OpenAPI spec; no GraphQL, MCP server, or CLI were found on comdirect.de.
